description: Codex: Orks (11e) WHIRLIGIG EVASION (Flyboyz, 1 CP) in the ENEMY's Movement phase through the real enemy_ended_move window. Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive: P1 Custodes active, P2 Orks. The Custodes player drags Custodian Guard Zeta 3" towards the Deffkoptas and locks the move in: the enemy unit ended within 8" of the DEFFKOPTAS, so the window opens for Player 2 with an enabled 'Use on Deffkoptas' button. A real click on Use spends P2's CP; the Deffkoptas are not riled up, so the D6 is rolled and caps the normal move. The Ork player drags the Deffkoptas 0.95" away and locks the move in; the Custodes player then has the phase back. Setup-only privileges: P2's detachment flipped to Flyboyz (stratagems reloaded); the Deffkoptas placed east of Custodian Guard Zeta.

steps.comment: setup privilege: Flyboyz for P2; Deffkoptas placed east of Custodian Guard Zeta
Skip Overwatch is on (harness default) — Fire Overwatch is not under test

steps.equals: Custodian Guard Zeta has ended a move
